tagline: 理光便携相机，1989 年发布
description: 理光于1989年推出的便携相机。配备38mm f/3.5 - 76mm f/6.7, 2.0X Zoom, 7 elements in 6 groups。快门速度3 - 1/500 sec.。感光度ISO 64 - 3200 (DX-code system)。Single-point active autofocusing system, 61 focusing steps。

specs.镜头: 38mm f/3.5 - 76mm f/6.7, 2.0X Zoom, 7 elements in 6 groups
specs.对焦: Single-point active autofocusing system, 61 focusing steps
specs.英文简介: The RZ-750 is an autofocus compact camera for 35mm film, introduced by Ricoh in 1989.
